subject: MAP: Procurement & Legal Sequencing for Pinecrest pilot — MSA / DPA / Order Form dependencies
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@pinecresthealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@pinecresthealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kick-off: MAP + evaluation timeline for Pinecrest pilot

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking this on. Pinecrest is aiming to start a 6‑week technical evaluation in June, with a target commercial close in early August. Procurement asked me to confirm a mutual action plan (MAP) that clearly lays out the sequencing for the MSA, DPA and Order Form so we can route approvals on our side. A few specifics from our end: 

- We need a completed DPA and SOC2 documentation before any data ingestion starts.
- Order Form & PO depend on final pricing and payment terms (we usually do net‑30 but can consider net‑45 for pilot).
- Legal will want to review redlines to the MSA and DPA concurrently if possible.

I attached the RFP appendix with our security questions and a short vendor checklist (Pinecrest_RFP_Appendix.pdf). Can you propose a sequencing timeline (milestones, owners, expected review times) that maps to our internal gates?

Also looping in Jordan Ellis (outside counsel — copied) for any legal Qs.

Best,
Sarah Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Pinecrest Health

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@pinecresthealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick-off: MAP + evaluation timeline for Pinecrest pilot

Sarah — really appreciate the clear ask and the appendix. Draft outline below (high level MAP + sequencing). I kept durations conservative so theres room for legal review and any SOC2 evidence pulls.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Week 0 (kickoff): MAP sign-off + data flow diagram (owner: Pinecrest) — 3 business days
2) Week 0-1: Security evidence upload (SOC2 report + data handling docs) (owner: Pinecrest / Redwood) — 10 business days
3) Week 1-2: MSA initial redlines (owner: Redwood legal / turn = 3 business days)
4) Week 1-3: DPA review & focused redlines (owner: Pinecrest legal + Redwood legal / turn = 5 business days)
5) Week 3: Order Form draft (price, pilot scope) — held pending MSA key commercial terms & DPA residency clauses
6) Week 4: DocuSign routing for MSA + DPA + Order Form (owner: mutual)
7) Week 5-6: Technical evaluation (redaction: if DPA not fully executed, use scoped trial with anonymized datasets and access controls)

Key dependencies / notes:
- MSA commercial redlines that affect billing (payment terms, termination) need parallel resolution; they directly gate the order form.
- DPA must include data residency and subprocessor list; if your security team needs vendor‑specific attestations we can provide a SOC2 letter and a short architecture note.
- If DocuSign is the preferred signature path we can prepare envelope templates; if you require PO-first, order form finalization will follow your PO issuance.

As next steps Ill: produce a one‑page MAP (milestones + owners) and a suggested DocuSign envelope. Karthik — can you review the sequencing below and flag any legal constraints (particularly around concurrent redlines for MSA/DPA)? Laura — can you own the attachment of the SOC2 letter & architecture note to the shared Drive?

I'll aim to share the MAP doc by Monday.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick-off: MAP + evaluation timeline for Pinecrest pilot

Avery — quick legal read: sequencing looks sensible, a few clarifications from Legal's perspective so we don't bottleneck later.

1) Parallel review: We can run MSA and DPA redline reviews in parallel but must lock the following MSA terms before Order Form execution: payment terms, liability cap, and acceptance criteria. If those remain open, we should include an explicit fallback in the Order Form that ties the pilot to limited liability and an acceptance signoff window.

2) DPA: please ask Pinecrest to confirm data categories and residency (EU/US/local DC). Our standard DPA contains a subprocessor appendix — we will circulate that, but expect back a short list of required residency or processing constraints. If Pinecrest requires custom audit rights beyond SOC2, there will be more lead time.

3) Signatures: DocuSign is preferred. If procurement requires a PO prior to the order form being sent, we can accept PO as proof of intent and follow with DocuSign signature; legal prefers the executed MSA/DPA before any production data access.

4) Suggested milestone adjustments: increase DPA review window to 7 business days (to accommodate external counsel). Also request a technical contact for evidence collection to avoid back‑and‑forth.

Ill prepare redline templates for both MSA and DPA and circulate them into the Drive folder once Avery shares the MAP doc.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

If you can share the one‑page MAP and a proposed DocuSign envelope by Monday EOD well align internal approvers and aim for an MSA/DPA redline window next week.
